The '''2014 World Championship''' was the fourth annual edition of the League of Legends World Championships held by Riot Games from September 18, 2014 to October 19th, 2014. The tournament was hosted for the first time in Asia, with the group stage matches held in both Taiwan and Singapore, with the quarterfinals held in Busan, South Korea, and the semi- and grand finals held in Seoul, South Korea at Sangam Stadium.

==Format==
* '''Qualifiers''' - ''August 13th - September 7th, 2014''
**Three Regional Finals.
***The winners of each Regional Final will advance to the World Championship.
***The runners-up and third place teams of the China Regional Final will advance to the World Championship.
**Two International Wildcard Qualifiers.
***The winner of each International Wildcard Qualifier will advance to the World Championship.
* '''Group Stage''' - ''September 18th - September 21st, 2014''
** All sixteen teams are divided into four groups where they play a Double Round Robin format.
*** All Matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** The top two teams in each group advance to the Knockout Stage.
*** The remaining teams are eliminated.
* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''October 3rd - October 19th, 2013''
** Eight teams play in a single elimination bracket over seven days.
*** Quarterfinals are {{Abbr/Bo3}}, all other rounds are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
